_readme: Your OWN business-calendar entries. Format: 'MM-DD..MM-DD' (year is inferred from the question). The engine ships with shipping-holiday defaults (Black Friday, Christmas, etc.); this file adds to them. Restart the app after editing. Keys starting with `_` are ignored.

_docs.format: 'MM-DD..MM-DD'. Both zero-padded. Windows may wrap year boundary (e.g. '12-26..01-02' → the last week of one year plus the first week of the next).
_docs.resolution: A phrase alone ('spring sale') resolves to the most recent past occurrence in the dataset. A phrase with a year ('spring sale 2017') pins it to that year.
_docs.collisions: If your key duplicates a shipped default (like 'black friday'), yours wins.
